evals.prompt: Make me 3 ad variations in Figma for our app. .agents/product-marketing.md has everything. Brand colour is #0B5FFF, font Inter.
evals.expected_output: Calls figma_get_status with probe true. Reads .agents/product-marketing.md, states in two lines what it used, and asks no intake questions. Presents one copy table with Pain, Desire, and Proof rows, paired platform copy with character counts, and the full image prompt, then stops for 'go'. After 'go', writes copy.md and prompt.txt, generates or skips the hero image, builds three frames inside a Section named 'Ads – <brand>', checks screenshots, and reports in the output format order.
assertions: Calls figma_get_status before building
Reads the shared context file and asks no intake questions
Copy table has exactly three rows: 01 Pain, 02 Desire, 03 Proof
Every headline is eight words or fewer
Every variation has two or three pills of three words or fewer
Hook, explainer, and support lines show character counts under 60, 120, and 255
Stops once for 'go' before writing files or building
All frames are created inside a Section named 'Ads – <brand>'
Contains no em dashes, exclamation marks, or banned words such as seamless or leverage

evals.prompt: ad message maker for my dog-walking business in Manchester. Figma isn't open right now.
evals.expected_output: Runs the Figma preflight, finds it not connected, and says in one line how to fix it without blocking. Finds no context file, suggests gtm-context without waiting, and asks the five intake questions in one message. After answers and 'go', writes copy.md, prompt.txt, and hero.png if an image backend exists. Final report says plainly that no frames were built and gives the setup fix.
assertions: States that Figma is not connected and gives the Desktop Bridge fix
Does not block intake on the missing Figma connection
Asks the five intake questions in a single message, with no follow-ups
Suggests gtm-context without waiting for it
Image prompt uses UK setting cues for Manchester
Never claims frames were created in Figma
Writes copy.md and prompt.txt to ./ads/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>/

evals.prompt: How do I set this skill up? I use Claude Code and I don't have Codex.
evals.expected_output: Explains the figma-console MCP (not the official Figma MCP) and why it is needed, the claude mcp add command with FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN, where to create the Figma personal access token, importing and running the Desktop Bridge plugin in Figma Desktop, and checking with figma_get_status. Explains that without Codex the hero image needs OPENAI_API_KEY for the OpenAI Images API, how to set it, and that without it the frames use a gradient background.
assertions: Names the figma-console MCP and says the official Figma MCP will not run the build script
Gives the claude mcp add command with FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN
Says Figma Desktop is required and explains the Desktop Bridge plugin import
Names OPENAI_API_KEY as the env var for image generation without Codex
Explains the gradient fallback when no image backend exists
Mentions keeping the key out of version control

evals.prompt: Three ads for our accounting firm. Proof point: we saved every client 40% on tax last year.
evals.expected_output: Uses the proof point in the Proof variation only if it is framed as the user's claim, and marks it 'needs checking' in the report because a blanket 40% saving is unverified and risky. Keeps each variation to one angle, uses plain language, and avoids banned SaaS words.
assertions: Marks the 40% claim as 'needs checking' in the report
Does not invent any additional statistics or reviews
Each variation carries one angle only
No headline is a question
Contains no em dashes or exclamation marks
